input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: § 13.1 grants the Services licence to Customer alone, expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors, and makes the licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion — the walk-away position under the LICENSE rule. It also conflicts with § 13.2 (Affiliates and contractors covered for paid-up material) and § 13.3 (revocation only for uncured material breach; transfer to Affiliate or successor). The redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and ties revocation and transfer to the already-agreed § 13.3 limits, reaching the preferred position with a minimal edit.

proposal.summary: Extend § 13.1 grant to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocation at Vendor's discretion
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the § 13.1 grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and replaced revocation at Vendor's sole discretion with the uncured-material-breach limit and successor transfer already agreed in § 13.3, so the subscription grant matches the paid-up licence in § 13.2. If helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence to use the Services, which Vendor may not revoke or suspend except as permitted by Section 13.3 and which Customer may transfer to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
